scope: identity/files resource owners and interfaces OAuth/session/upload consumers
evidence: Source-derived unexecuted scenarios. File hash/anchor metadata verification only; no product runtime/build/test/install/network/Git/repo writes. Test/comment evidence is not policy authority. No new security mechanism adopted.

stages.P1: Implemented public owner primitives; tests/source calls do not prove production assembly.
stages.P2: Full interfaces auth/OAuth/upload callbacks/canonical file joints unmounted in interim Worker; DESIGN613-617 unimplemented bridge/adapter contracts.
stages.P3: Production D1 assembly, /mcp/grants issuer and identity admissions in source; actual deployment not exercised.

resources.identity: user/team UUID; normalized email UNIQUE; stored password hash; team timezone UTC default
resources.lifecycle: Normalize/policy/existing check -> hash -> unverified user -> verify token -> mail; teams create independently. No disable/user/team delete port.
invariants: D1 normalized-email UNIQUE; unverified login refused.
failure_scenarios: Mail fails after inserts: unverified account/token retained; registration retry conflicts before mail. Crash after user insert before token insert leaves no link. Concurrent absent-email readers: loser SQL UNIQUE, not feature conflict.
gaps: Resend/disposal absent; no deletion policy inferred; no DDL foreign-key cascade.

resources.identity: PBKDF2 modular hash; salt16/key32/600000 iterations; temporary password UTF8 bytes/CryptoKey/derived arrays
resources.lifecycle: Policy -> salt -> nonextractable key/derive -> stored encoding. Verify parse/derive/native compare; temporary UTF8/key arrays/CryptoKey GC, no wipe API.
invariants: Malformed encoding/derivation false; native faults throw; bearer hash is exact text.
failure_scenarios: Policy fails before account effect; missing native compare before session insert. Malformed stored verifier refuses.
gaps: GC proves no timed erasure; host primitive availability prerequisite; no new zeroization policy.

resources.identity: token_id UUID/hash UNIQUE/purpose verify_email; default24h; raw addressed-mail bearer
resources.lifecycle: Hash insert/mail -> purpose/live/unconsumed -> set verified -> consume. Terminal/expired row retained.
invariants: Sequential replay refuses; wrong purpose/expiry fails before write.
failure_scenarios: A/B live readers: both set verified and return success; conditional consume void does not report loser. Verified=true is idempotent. Crash before consume permits repeat.
gaps: Atomic winner+side effect unresolved mechanism; no terminal-row sweep.

resources.identity: recover_account token_id/hash; default1h; affected password/sessions/grants
resources.lifecycle: Request unknown/malformed ok; known revoke old -> new token -> mail. Recover policy/live -> password update -> consume -> recovery links -> sessions -> grants.
invariants: Completed rotation revokes old credentials; invalid link no password write.
failure_scenarios: Crash after password write leaves old credentials; after consume before cascade retry refuses, cannot finish. A/B token readers rotate different passwords. Concurrent requests revoke before creates: two live links. Mail throws after replacement stored.
gaps: Atomic/recoverable cascade required; mechanism unresolved. Uniform unknown-email ok does not cover mail failure.

resources.identity: session_id/hash UNIQUE/raw can_session cookie; default7d; nullable selected-team hint
resources.lifecycle: Password -> durable session -> cookie. Admission live row/user; signout revoke+clear; everywhere sessions then grants. Expired/revoked rows retained.
invariants: Exact expiry boundary denies; cookie HttpOnly/Secure default/Lax; unknown revoke idempotent.
failure_scenarios: Response/cookie failure after insert leaves unseen live session. Logout resolve IO error catch returns ok/clear without server revoke. Everywhere crash after sessions leaves grants live.
gaps: Cookie maxAge differs server TTL knobs; server authoritative. No sweep or external-cookie recall.

resources.identity: UUID/hash; default10min; raw no-store descriptor token
resources.lifecycle: Descriptor throttle/store/no-store; login throttle/parse -> find -> DELETE -> expiry -> required credentials/login. Unpresented rows retained.
invariants: Missing/unknown no deletion; live proof burns before bad credentials.
failure_scenarios: A/B find before DELETE: both void deletes return true. Lost descriptor leaves expired never-presented row without sweep. Limiter refuses before consume; missing fields after consume burn.
gaps: Atomic take required; origin/browser binding AD gap unresolved, no exploit claim.

resources.identity: HMAC-SHA256(session bearer,can-csrf-v1); transient key/mac; no independent stored proof row
resources.lifecycle: Derive HMAC proof -> header/field -> expected/compare; rotation changes proof; no stored row; transient GC.
invariants: Possession proof requires separate live session/authority.
failure_scenarios: Prior proof cannot revive revoked admission; snapshot during long upload needs owning recheck.
gaps: No independent disposal. Presession-origin gap separate.

resources.identity: client_<8randombyteshex>; public identifier, name, exact registered redirect URI strings
resources.lifecycle: Registration bounds/URI checks -> store/respond; authorize exact URI; no edit/revoke/delete/expiry API.
invariants: 1..5 HTTPS/loopback redirects; no fragment/userinfo; public ID not secret.
failure_scenarios: Lost response leaves unused client; retry new client. ID collision SQL error, no local retry.
gaps: Client disposal/quota absent; not grant TTL.

resources.identity: opaque code hash/client/user/team/redirect/S256 challenge; default10min/consumed timestamp
resources.lifecycle: Session/member/CSRF -> URI/challenge -> code store/redirect. Exchange live -> client/URI -> PKCE -> consume -> grant/respond; mint failure keeps code spent.
invariants: Bad PKCE/client/URI fails before consume; valid43 S256 reachable.
failure_scenarios: A/B pass live+PKCE: A consumes, B UPDATE zero returns void; both mint. Crash after consume before grant spends without grant; response loss after grant leaves unseen bearer. IP09 admitted44 challenge never equals43 digest; failed PKCE leaves code live until expiry.
gaps: Atomic winner needed; lost-response/replay security compatibility choice unresolved. Issuing session not rechecked; future grant membership is. No sweep.

resources.identity: grant_id UUID/hash; bound user/team/client; default30days/raw bearer once
resources.lifecycle: Authenticated issue -> client validation -> store/respond; live grant/user/team per admission; revoke single/user/team; no refresh/sweep.
invariants: Team bound; removed member denied even if timestamp cascade fails; hash only stored.
failure_scenarios: Production session/member resolve then await req.json then mint: revoke/everywhere can finish before new grant is inserted. Removal before mint still denied by next membership gate. Response loss leaves unseen bearer.
gaps: Issuer/commit fence reconciliation needed; no bypass from public export.

resources.identity: UUID/addressed normalized email/stored owner+role ceiling; default7days; accepted/revoked timestamps
resources.lifecycle: Owner check -> invite/mail; accept live -> verified addressed user -> inactive/absent member -> reactivate/create -> accept mark.
invariants: Stored ceiling; unique(team,user); invitation ID alone insufficient.
failure_scenarios: Crash member write before accept mark: retry Already member conflict. Different reactivation ceilings can overwrite after both inactive reads; UNIQUE not UPDATE guard. Mail failure leaves undelivered live invite.
gaps: Atomic admission/consume/cascade needed; terminal invitation rows retained.

resources.identity: membership_id, unique(team,user), active/removed, owner, attributed role-grant array
resources.lifecycle: Provision/invite -> active; owner roles/remove. Removed row historical; reactivate fresh ceiling. Remove -> grants -> invites.
invariants: Sequential last-owner guard; stable history ID; new admissions active.
failure_scenarios: Two owners both see2 then demote/remove different targets ->0. Role grants read[] then [x]/[y]: lost update. Crash removed before cascade leaves invitations able to re-admit until revoke; grant admission denies.
gaps: Known atomic-gap; DESIGN291 admitted finish vs helper strict fence needs reconciliation.

resources.identity: nullable session.last_team_id; no credential/cache authority
resources.lifecycle: Live session/team/member -> hint write; clear live -> null; next admission resolves again.
invariants: Hint grants nothing.
failure_scenarios: Removal after checks saves stale hint but next admission rechecks. Two tabs last-writer.
gaps: UI private-cache clearing outside helper; disposal with session.

resources.identity: ResolvedIdentity actor/team/membership/binding/admitted_at request snapshot
resources.lifecycle: Injected clock -> reject dual credentials -> store reads -> snapshot. Optional current credential/member rereads; current regrant wins checkpoint.
invariants: Read then separate write is not atomic fence.
failure_scenarios: Upload resolves before body buffering; revocation/expiry before append still uses snapshot, no live helper call. Assert then write separately also races.
gaps: Conditional unmounted callback; canonical writer/revision fence+DESIGN291 reconciliation unresolved.

resources.identity: ten tables/indexes; caller D1 DB/Clock/Random/Mail ports; ephemeral host statement handles
resources.lifecycle: Validate DB -> sequential idempotent DDL -> one-statement store. Restart durable rows; host owns DB/statements.
invariants: Bind values+UNIQUE; partial schema ensure safely retried.
failure_scenarios: Feature crash leaves committed prefix; expiry denies without erasure.
gaps: No batch/transaction/take rowcount/sweep/user delete; no lifecycle backlog metrics here.

resources.identity: intent_id port-minted; global retry upload_id; op/field/args/name/declared size/receiver; five state variants
resources.lifecycle: Bind -> shape/absent slot/size/url/cap -> retry lookup -> duplicate/conflict or mint/clone/open put; content/final or reject/expire.
invariants: Foreign/context drift refused; finalization not business acceptance.
failure_scenarios: Shared clients both retry-absent can mint/put twice; no CAS/unique put. Lost response retries grant. Expired duplicate still returns old grant; append then refuses.
gaps: Full writable schema/context/current authority P2. Global retry scope unresolved; no delete/cursor port.

resources.identity: u_<intent_id>.part; receivedBytes vs declaredSize; actual content/digest
resources.lifecycle: Live-owned-open -> count bounds -> blob append -> count/put; partial kept; invalid/oversize/expiry delete/reset. Complete count==declared then actual MIME/policy cap.
invariants: Foreign/closed before write; missing counted staging rejects; detected type wins.
failure_scenarios: Persistent copy-returning metadata: declared1/count0/text, append A persists blob then crash before count put; retry A ->AA/count1; complete count1==1 and actual2<=cap accepts; finalize metadata size1 but digest/blob AA. Memory aliases not crash proof. HTTP partial PUT A lost-response retry blindly appends; declared2 can complete AA rather than AB.
gaps: Blob/count/declaration and chunk replay need guarded durable append mechanism; shared races require multiple clients, not same-isolate sync interleave.

resources.identity: opaque file ref, f_<ref>.bin, frozen file/provenance/time, mutable lifecycle row
resources.lifecycle: Complete/digest -> mint/freeze -> finalblob write -> staging remove -> files put -> intent final/ref put; repeat stable ref even tombstone.
invariants: Digest conflicts before writes; retry never resurrects bytes.
failure_scenarios: Crash after final write before row untracked blob; after staging remove before row retry conflict; after file row before intent row orphan ref undiscovered. Multiple-store-owner reads can mint twice.
gaps: Atomic/recoverable cross-store phases required; mechanism unresolved.

resources.identity: provider adapter/delivery/path retry; event source/adapter/occurrence/field/item; receiver provenance
resources.lifecycle: Provider retry intent/prefix resume/final; event validated verified-caller provenance/bytes -> mint -> blob -> row. Authentic ingress external.
invariants: Provider prefix drift conflicts unchanged; collected/rejected retry no replacement.
failure_scenarios: Repeated event occurrence/item directly mints twice, no dedup map. Crash blob before row untracked bytes. adapter a:b/delivery c and adapter a/delivery b:c same provider retry text.
gaps: Occurrence dedup/conflict/correlation owning ingress P2; retry encoding compatibility unresolved.

resources.identity: single attachedRecord string plus ref/exact app-team-owner-principal tuple
resources.lifecycle: State/owner authorize -> attached/recordRef; state/exact-owner reads; receipt availability summary. No detach/refcount/download route.
invariants: ID alone no read; foreign/collected/missing bytes null.
failure_scenarios: Live row missing blob: files-only authorize and attach succeed, bytes read null. Attach A then B overwrites sole attachedRecord. Foreign collected ref expired before owner check: bounded existence distinction, no bypass claimed.
gaps: Canonical record/field readable reuse/download/destination/shared-reference release P2 per DESIGN580/601.

resources.identity: open/complete intent expiry; finalized/attached/orphaned/expired row; finalizedAt-based horizons; retained summary/retry metadata
resources.lifecycle: Explicit retention validate/now/listAll: due intent delete staging+expired; due final delete+expired or unattached delete+orphan. Terminal rows retained; receipt live+blob only.
invariants: Attached skips orphan horizon, not retention; remove idempotent; no resurrection.
failure_scenarios: Crash delete before stateput leaves live metadata/no bytes; next pass can finish, attach gate meanwhile passes. No installed driver found; no read/attach clock check, overdue object usable before sweep.
gaps: Required stable resumable batches/current-owner lifetime/shared blockers/release-before-delete/backlog absent. No exact erasure-second promise.

resources.identity: caller absolute rootDir; safe flat keys; per-call OS descriptors/read buffers
resources.lifecycle: Caller absolute root mkdir -> safe key -> sync IO; OS per-call handles; copied reads; blob remove; no root/tempdir dispose.
invariants: Traversal string denied; ENOENT null, other IO faults throw; local API not R2 binding.
failure_scenarios: Malicious local root/key symlink can follow outside target despite safe key (local-control prerequisite, not HTTP traversal). Crash lacks metadata transaction/fsync guarantee.
gaps: Caller temp-root cleanup/trust and durability profile; test teardown not product guarantee.

resources.identity: per-transfer maxBytes; no aggregate quota ledger/reservation ID/lease in ports
resources.lifecycle: Per-intent declaration/count/actual-byte cap; no quota reservation ledger created/released here.
invariants: Transfer cap is not aggregate reservation.
failure_scenarios: Many valid open intents accumulate storage; future concurrent quota checks need guarded reserve. Untracked blobs escape metadata-only accounting.
gaps: Required quota/orphan owner P2; mechanism/lease/accounting not selected.

resources.identity: runtime-derived ReceivingContext tuple; normalized HTTPS BridgeOrigin; request authorization snapshot
resources.lifecycle: Bridge resolves per call; interface usesFiles -> grant/session audience/live identity -> sessionCSRF -> runtime receiver -> kernel delegation.
invariants: No body-appointed identity; null/foreign deny; safe HTTPS origin; host fallback.
failure_scenarios: Team switch changes tuple; snapshot before body outlives revocation. Caller-claim resolver would violate port contract, not prove live binding.
gaps: Full authority/schema/R2/attachment/download/retention P2. Interim Worker refuses configured kernel without identity joint; no public-upload bypass.

controls_and_limits: Identity per-method SQL/UNIQUE is not whole-feature atomicity; expiry is logical, not erasure. Files sync one-isolate calls cannot internally interleave; shared races require multiple clients/processes. Test maps alias objects and prove no crash persistence.

Durable metadata copy-returning seams explicitly prerequisite for file crash scenarios; FS bytes restart independently. No production R2 binder/retention schedule inferred. No auth bypass from helper/test export; public API/default/compiler ownership retained.
External browser/mail/provider copies and host sockets separately owned; no local timed-erasure guarantee.

coverage.other_classification: comparison host selectors and index/distribution/catalog exports have no separate owned lifecycle; testing.ts and t16/t32 tests are scenario evidence only; files scenarios.ts deliberately empty inventory. No source omitted.

omissions: All40 scoped src TS mapped. Test behavior not exhaustively audited/executed. Root owns HTTP reader/instrumentation/export/print/CSV/MCP outer lifecycles, inherited file coverage and docs/Git; external host/provider lifetime outside owner.
